run_blob_triangulation: run the ROS node to triangulate barycenters of colored blobs from camera images
run_with_robot_flag: run the blob triangulation node with a specific robot name via the --robot flag
run_with_props_flag: run the blob triangulation node tracking specific colored props via the --props flag
run_with_max_invalid_caminfo: run the blob triangulation node with a custom max invalid camera info retry limit
review_main: review the main function that collects config, validates camera intrinsics, and spins the ROS node
